text:
sophie: Quick brain-dump after the meeting: propose a "compact manifest" used across hosted/dedicated/private. Goal: routing + auth + migration hints in one signed blob.

devin: Sounds good. Minimal fields I care about: tenant_tag (hashed), affinity_hint, secret_locator (opaque), manifest_v, ttl, resolve_mode.

amar: Agree but we must be explicit about who can resolve secret_locator. Hosted can resolve host-kms:// only if allowlisted; private must never receive host-kms://.

nora: Add negotiation vector: control-plane advertises caps_allowed, adapter replies caps_supported. If mismatch -> HANDSHAKE_MISMATCH and clear error.

sophie: Example compact manifest text for discussion: `{"tenant_tag":"h-9d2f","affinity_hint":"zone-1","secret_locator":"kms://r/abcd","resolve_mode":"on-demand","ttl":300,"manifest_v":"2","caps_allowed":["resolve_kms","cache_tokens"]}`

devin: Keep that machine-readable example in the RFC but make sure adapters treat secret_locator as opaque until capability negotiation passes.

amar: Error taxonomy: RESOLVE_TEMP (retry/backoff), RESOLVE_PERM (do not retry -> fallback or abort), POLICY_DENIED (abort + audit). Map these to runtime behavior in spec.

nora: Migration: include migration_id + grace_seconds so when affinity moves we issue short-lived migration manifests and allow caches to warm. Otherwise we hit cold-cache storms.

sophie: Telemetry: include telemetry_tag = HMAC(tenant_id, rotation_key) so traces are correlation-safe. Also require audit_nonce and signed_manifest_id.

devin: For private mode, secret_locator should be local://path or token://short-lived. Control plane must enforce that host-kms:// is not used in private installs.

amar: Capability vector sketch: can_resolve_kms, can_cache_creds, allows_inline_keys, migration_aware. Negotiate before any resolution.

nora: Also require caps_hash so adapter verifies the vector integrity. On mismatch abort with MANIFEST_HASH_MISMATCH.

sophie: Fallback hints: degrade_to_small_model | route_to_fallback_pool | fail_request. Manifest can include fallback_hint so routing is deterministic.

devin: Add resolve_policy enum: eager (resolve at handshake), lazy (resolve on first use), external (external exchange). Each has tradeoffs for latency and security.

amar: Operational runbook: if RESOLVE_TEMP persists beyond ttl/2 -> control plane issues migration manifest to new affinity and start grace_seconds. If RESOLVE_PERM -> immediate fallback.

nora: Also add manifest_versioning rule: bump requires adapters to fail-fast with MANIFEST_UNSUPPORTED so we don't get silent misbehaviors. Provide deprecation window in RFC.

sophie: Action items: 1) devin to draft JSON Schema for manifest_v=2, 2) amar to write KMS capability matrix and private MUST_NOTs, 3) nora to add telemetry and migration sections. I'll draft RFC after those.

handshake-bot: preflight: schema-check queued (manifest_v2), migration-sim started, kms-policy-tests pending.

devin: I'll include example hosted vs private manifests in the PR and a small test harness for RESOLVE_* error conditions.

amar: I'll include RBAC examples showing which service accounts can request manifests that allow host-kms resolution.

nora: I'll propose a short eval plan to surface cache-staleness during migration.

sophie: Great. Planning to open RFC draft tonight unless anyone objects. Quick :thumbsup: if ok.

devin: :thumbsup:

amar: +1

handshake-bot: ci: manifest-schema-tests passed locally, kms-policy-tests queued.
